title: Wall-Mounted Tumbler Toothbrush Holder, Solid Brass, 4.5-Inch | Brushed Bronze | Brass Toothbrush Holders | Allied Brass
body_html:
Free up bathroom counter space and keep daily essentials organized with a wall-mounted tumbler toothbrush holder designed for a clean, finished look in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

  • Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Looks clean after installation thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Makes it easy to coordinate with other pieces in the Brass Toothbrush Holders collection and multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Installation
Material: Solid brass
Mounting: Wall-mounted; concealed screw hardware included
Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 4.7 x 3.5 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 in.
Shipping weight: 3 lbs
Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.

Style fit: Transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.
